toegepas.voor: die eerste hulp tot beter hulp daar is
toegepas.na: die eerste hulp totdat beter hulp daar is
toegepas.rede_vinder: As a conjunction before a clause 'totdat' is the standard form, and it matches the glossary definition of noodhulp.
toegepas.fout: 'tot' as a clause conjunction is weaker than 'totdat' and the running text drifts from the noodhulp glossary wording
toegepas.rede_keurder: Totdat is the standard conjunction here and brings the sentence in line with the glossary definition without moving the meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dit' could refer to the pressing or the wound; naming the bleeding makes clear what must stop.
toegepas.fout: 'hou aan druk tot dit ophou' leaves 'dit' and 'ophou' unclear next to 'hou aan'
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the bleeding states plainly what must stop, with the instruction unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Deurkom' is the everyday word for blood soaking through a cloth and suits Grade 6 better than 'deurdring'.
toegepas.fout: 'deurdring' is bookish for blood soaking through a cloth
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Deurkom' is the plain everyday word for a Grade 6 reader and the meaning stays the same.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Druk om dit' can be misread; 'rondom' says clearly that you press around the object.
toegepas.fout: 'druk om dit' is not natural Afrikaans and can be misread
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Rondom dit' says clearly that you press around the object.

toegepas.voor: as 'n wond diep is of wyd oopstaan of vuil in het
toegepas.na: as 'n wond diep is, wyd oopstaan of vuil in het
toegepas.rede_vinder: A list of three conditions takes a comma and one 'of', not a chain of 'of'.
toegepas.fout: a chain of 'of ... of' reads wooden
toegepas.rede_keurder: A comma and one 'of' is the normal list form and the three conditions stay the same.

toegepas.voor: stoom of ander warm vloeistof en kry dieselfde.
toegepas.na: stoom of 'n ander warm vloeistof en kry dieselfde behandeling.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The article is missing before 'ander warm vloeistof' (the glossary has it), and 'kry dieselfde' is vague without a noun.
toegepas.fout: missing article before 'ander warm vloeistof' and a vague 'kry dieselfde'
toegepas.rede_keurder: The article matches the glossary and 'behandeling' completes the sentence without adding content.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A list of three takes a comma and one 'en'.
toegepas.fout: 'en ... en' chain in a list of three

toegepas.rede_vinder: A list of three takes a comma and one 'of'.
toegepas.fout: 'of ... of' chain in a list of three

toegepas.voor: en bedek dit los met iets skoons
toegepas.na: en bedek die brandwond los met iets skoons
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dit' follows the plural 'blase' and so has no clear antecedent; the burn is what gets covered.
toegepas.fout: singular 'dit' straight after plural 'blase' has no clear antecedent
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the burn removes the stumble and keeps what the paragraph means.

toegepas.voor: Blase oor 'n groot stuk vel, koors of naarheid vra 'n grootmens en die kliniek.
toegepas.na: By blase oor 'n groot stuk vel, koors of naarheid het jy 'n grootmens en die kliniek nodig.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Vra' reads as 'ask', so a learner may think the blisters ask the adult; 'het jy ... nodig' keeps the meaning without the misreading.
toegepas.fout: 'Blase ... vra 'n grootmens' reads as if the blisters ask someone
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Het jy ... nodig' keeps the same instruction and is easy for a Grade 6 reader.

toegepas.voor: Hou 'n rukkie 'n koue lap daarop of ys toegedraai in 'n lap.
toegepas.na: Hou 'n koue lap, of ys wat in 'n lap toegedraai is, 'n rukkie daarop.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The second object trails after 'daarop' with an English-style participle; grouping both objects before 'daarop' reads naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'of ys toegedraai in 'n lap' trails after 'daarop' in an English-style construction
toegepas.rede_keurder: Grouping both options before 'daarop' reads naturally and keeps the wrapped-ice instruction intact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Reguit' means straight; 'direk' is the word for touching the skin without anything between.
toegepas.fout: 'reguit op die vel' is looser than the usual phrase
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Direk op die vel' is the natural, exact wording for nothing in between.

toegepas.voor: as die deel baie seer is of swel of nie wil beweeg nie
toegepas.na: as die deel baie seer is, swel of nie wil beweeg nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: A list of three conditions takes a comma and one 'of'.
toegepas.fout: 'of ... of' chain in a list of three conditions

toegepas.voor: Roep dadelik 'n grootmens as iemand iets giftigs gesluk het en wys die houer.
toegepas.na: Roep dadelik 'n grootmens en wys die houer as iemand iets giftigs gesluk het.
toegepas.rede_vinder: As written, 'en wys die houer' can attach to the person who swallowed the poison; moving it beside 'Roep' makes clear the reader shows the container.
toegepas.fout: 'en wys die houer' after the 'as' clause makes the reader stumble over who shows it
toegepas.rede_keurder: Placing it beside 'Roep' keeps the same actions in the same order and makes clear the reader shows the container.

toegepas.voor: en te veel van sy eie.
toegepas.na: en vir te veel van sy eie medisyne.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The elliptical ending is hard to parse; repeating 'vir' and the noun completes the parallel.
toegepas.fout: the elliptical 'en te veel van sy eie' is hard to parse
toegepas.rede_keurder: Completing the parallel says the same thing more clearly.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma after the relative clause stops 'verstik hoes' being read as one verb group.
toegepas.fout: 'wat verstik hoes' runs two verbs together and makes the reader stumble
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma after the relative clause makes the sentence readable on first pass.

toegepas.na: met jou vingers in sy mond
toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans names whose fingers; the bare 'met vingers' sounds translated.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Afrikaans names whose fingers, and the instruction is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: waarmee 'n by of ander insek steek
toegepas.na: waarmee 'n by of 'n ander insek steek
toegepas.rede_vinder: The singular 'ander insek' needs its article.
toegepas.fout: singular 'ander insek' is missing its article
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain grammar fix in the glossary entry that leaves the meaning untouched.

laat_vaar.na: langer alleen as wat nodig is nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The comparison reads incomplete without 'wat nodig is'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'langer as nodig' is a normal idiomatic Afrikaans comparison and the proposal only makes it longer.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Iemand anders se' is the natural Afrikaans form; ''n ander se' is stiff.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: ''n ander se bloed' is correct Afrikaans and the proposal is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Hiervan' points vaguely back over several sentences; naming the signs is clearer.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Hiervan' covers the sting in the mouth or throat too, which is not strictly a sign, so 'tekens' would narrow it.

laat_vaar.voor: Gee niks te eet of drink nie
laat_vaar.na: Gee niks te eet of te drink nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Both infinitives take 'te' in standard Afrikaans.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'niks te eet of drink nie' is accepted idiomatic Afrikaans, so the change is lateral.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Keer' is ambiguous here (stop or turn); 'onmoontlik maak' says the same thing clearly.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'keer' meaning prevent is clear and correct, and a glossary definition should not be reworded for a lateral gain.

na_skrywer.voor: begin terselfdertyd wat nie kan wag nie
na_skrywer.na: begin terselfdertyd met wat nie kan wag nie
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Begin met' is the natural construction before an object clause; the protected word 'terselfdertyd' stays.
na_skrywer.fout: 'begin terselfdertyd wat nie kan wag nie' lacks the natural 'met'
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fix is real, but this is the fact-checked safety instruction quoted in the protected list, so the writer must change it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
